reasons.plausibility: The tribo‐corrosion mechanisms and microstructural arguments given for AlCoCrFeNi2.1 vs. DS2205 are scientifically coherent in their own right, but they do not address WTaTiVZr vs. tungsten under high-temperature service conditions, so the plausibility is moderately sound as a steel/HEA tribo‐corrosion study but not directly for the stated question.
reasons.testability: The hypothesis presents clearly defined experimental methods (thermal shock, tribo‐corrosion testing, wear measurement), making it testable by direct comparison of measured wear rates, friction, and corrosion response against a baseline.
reasons.usefulness: Because it is focused on a different set of materials (AlCoCrFeNi2.1 vs. DS2205) and conditions (aqueous tribo‐corrosion) than WTaTiVZr vs. tungsten in a high‐temperature plasma‐facing environment, it is not directly useful for addressing the original question.
